top_news.title: Microsoft's Decision-1 model enters the fast-growing AI decision model race
top_news.dek: Microsoft has released Decision-1, a specialized model optimized for high-speed classification and routing tasks.
top_news.brief: Built on the Qwen3.5-9B architecture, Decision-1 is designed to handle structured decision-making tasks like routing and classification. Microsoft reports an 83.5 percent accuracy rate with 85 ms latency across 36 benchmarks, positioning it as a competitor to existing decision-focused models from OpenAI and Cloudflare.

top_news.title: Talorys – A self-hosted personal AI agent on Cloudflare's free tier
top_news.dek: Talorys is an open-source personal AI agent designed to run entirely within a user's own Cloudflare account.
top_news.brief: Talorys provides chat, memory, task management, and scheduled reminders without requiring external servers or third-party databases. It is designed for single-user privacy, operates on Cloudflare's free tier, and can be deployed via a single command.

primary.title: Presentation: Ontology‐Driven Observability: Building the E2E Knowledge Graph at Netflix Scale
primary.summary: Prasanna Vijayanathan and Renzo Sanchez-Silva share how Netflix tackles observability across 38M events/sec.
